claims: Spring is the temperate season between winter and summer.
In 2026, the Northern Hemisphere spring officially begins with the vernal equinox on March 20.
The 2026 vernal equinox occurs on March 20 at 10:46 a.m. EDT.
The 2026 vernal equinox marks the moment the sun crosses the equator.
Spring typically spans March-May in the Northern Hemisphere.
Spring typically spans September-November in the Southern Hemisphere.
Meteorologists often define spring as lasting from March 1 to May 31.
The vernal equinox is the moment when the center of the sun crosses Earth's equator.
The vernal equinox results in nearly equal lengths of day and night across the planet.
The vernal equinox is considered the astronomical start of spring in the Northern Hemisphere.
